subject: HDR bloom postprocess chain black screen after mobile tab switch and float FBO attachment error
assumptions: The black screen on mobile occurs either because RGBA16F FBO attachments lack EXT_color_buffer_float or because backgrounding the tab triggers an unhandled webglcontextlost event.
Feedback loops may also occur if the bloom downsample pass samples the same texture level currently attached to COLOR_ATTACHMENT0.
derivations: RGBA16F renderability requires gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_float') !== null; linear filtering on float textures additionally requires gl.getExtension('OES_texture_float_linear') !== null
Bloom mip chain size for 1920x1080 across 5 downsample levels = sum_{i=1..5} (1920/2^i)*(1080/2^i)*8 bytes = 5.53 MB using immutable gl.texStorage2D
key_decisions: Gate RGBA16F FBO allocation behind gl.getExtension('EXT_color_buffer_float') and fall back to R11F_G11F_B10F or RGBA8 when the extension is absent or checkFramebufferStatus !== FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE.

Attach webglcontextlost (calling event.preventDefault() and cancelAnimationFrame) and webglcontextrestored handlers that recreate shaders, VAOs, UBOs, samplers, and FBOs from scratch without calling delete* on stale handles.
Guard the bright-pass extraction shader against negative or NaN radiance values using max(color.rgb, vec3(0.0)) and clamp(luminance, 0.0, MAX_BLOOM_LUMA) before downsampling.
parallel_tasks: inspect FBO attachment formats and checkFramebufferStatus codes while auditing shader bright-pass math for NaN propagation
add WEBGL_lose_context automated drill in parallel with separating ping-pong bloom FBO attachments
risks: A single NaN texel in the bright-pass filter expands across the entire 5-level Gaussian downsample pyramid, turning the composite frame black.
Calling gl.drawArrays for fullscreen postprocess passes without a bound VAO fails with INVALID_OPERATION in WebGL 2.0.
Reusing pre-loss WebGLTexture or WebGLFramebuffer references after webglcontextrestored silently fails or raises INVALID_OPERATION.
next_steps: query EXT_color_buffer_float and OES_texture_float_linear at context init and verify gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) === gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE
sanitize bright-pass shader inputs with max(rgb, vec3(0.0)) and replace any pow(x, y) calls with pow(max(x, 0.0), y)
register webglcontextlost and webglcontextrestored listeners and test recovery with gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context').loseContext()
verify non-black output via PBO + gl.fenceSync pixel readback at viewport center
validation_gates: gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) returns gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE (0x8CD5) on every ping-pong bloom FBO
Simulated WEBGL_lose_context loseContext() + restoreContext() recovers rendering within 1 frame with gl.getError() === gl.NO_ERROR
